scientific_contract.scope: A reduced distance-three building block with an ideal encoded input: synthesize one physical flagged stabilizer-measurement gadget and a deterministic recovery table for each scrambled Steane logical-zero case.
scientific_contract.strict_one_fault_criterion: For every declared single Pauli fault, every raw data error with target-state-stabilizer coset weight above one must raise the flag, and the one common recovery indexed by the observed check bit, flag bit, and ideal trailing six-bit code syndrome must leave a data Pauli equivalent modulo the full signed logical-zero target stabilizer to weight at most one.
scientific_contract.claim_boundary: This is target-state flag-safety, not an arbitrary-logical-data flag guarantee, because the quotient includes the logical-Z state generator. The encoded data input is ideal. The gadget, ancilla preparation, and ancilla measurements are faulted. The trailing full-code syndrome extraction and returned Pauli recovery are ideal. Atomic dressed-CX variants have ideal Clifford action CX; their non-Pauli coherent dressing is used only by scenario scoring. This prototype is not a complete deterministic fault-tolerant preparation, threshold calculation, or hardware noise claim.

framework.centrality: The expert must use TensorCircuit to rank binary-valid physical gadgets and calibrated CX-variant assignments by coherent state fidelity. GF(2) may prune faults and synthesize the decoder, but a TensorCircuit import without artifact-determining circuit simulation is insufficient.

contract.oracle: Independent phase-aware GF(2) exhaustive fault propagation plus a TensorCircuit-free complex128 NumPy statevector scorer and dense toy canary

reference_algorithm.search: For each case, enumerate 5 checks x 24 support orders x 6 flag windows, synthesize a common 256-row decoder for every flag-safe structure, rank structures with TensorCircuit on the public nominal coherent model, then enumerate six opaque variant choices under the cost budget for the twelve best structures.
reference_algorithm.tensorcircuit_centrality: Circuit.cnot, Circuit.unitary, and Circuit.state determine the selected check, order, flag window, and five costly-variant placements; the returned artifact changes measured coherent fidelity.
reference_algorithm.oracle_independence: The verifier never imports the expert. It separately enumerates 99 ideal/single-fault branches per case using phase-aware binary Pauli propagation and scores 9-qubit circuits with dense NumPy tensor application. An exhaustive 4^7 Pauli canary confirms zero disagreements between literal target-stabilizer coset weight <=1 and the full seven-generator syndrome criterion.
reference_algorithm.expected_complexity: Two 720-structure searches plus at most 64 variant assignments on twelve finalists per case; state dimension is 2^9=512. The local shim run is well below the 300 second contract, but pinned TensorCircuit runtime and peak RSS remain promotion gates.

generator_and_admission.identity_protocol: The verifier flushes {orbit_q_case_identity:{protocol_seed,case_digest}} before spawning the solution. The digest commits to the public config and a digest of verifier-only scenarios. A CLI seed conflicting with verifier-owned environment input is rejected.
generator_and_admission.hidden_entropy: The oracle seed is never sent to the solution process or printed. This design-only file has deterministic local self-test entropy; executable promotion must supply fresh verifier-only entropy and remove any development default from solver-visible packaging.
generator_and_admission.admission_rule: Every fully regenerated baseline artifact below includes an independently synthesized valid 256-row decoder. Because the hidden scenario set includes the public nominal model, a nominal score at least 0.001 below the floor proves rejection under the min-scenario rule.
generator_and_admission.functional_mutants: No-gadget and schema/type mutants fail; both selected gadgets contain dangerous data-CNOT hook branches caught by the flag; each has an allowed wrong flag window that fails flag safety; a reachable recovery mutation fails common recovery. The reviewer recipe is first candidate + sorted support + [0,3] + costly variants at indices 1,3,4,5.

A quantum scientist must review the signed target stabilizer, ancilla directions and bases, exhaustive one-fault locations, ideal trailing-syndrome assumption, and atomic dressed-CX claim boundary.
Run the <=160-line expert with real TensorCircuit in the pinned image; verify custom-gate ordering, complex128 fidelity, TC-call centrality, runtime below 180 seconds, and peak memory.
Recheck threshold and >=0.001 admission margins on at least 25 separately hashed generated cases; this local prototype proves them only for the default two-case development identity.

Before accepting externally supplied configurations, validate the full Steane assumptions rather than trusting the internal generator: n=7, binary row shapes, CSS orthogonality, independent rank-three X/Z checks, logical-Z commutation/independence, and distance three.
Promote full multi-gadget Steane and Shor-scale variants only as future separately hashed candidates; do not broaden this single-gadget claim in place.
Use isolated solution and scorer processes with verifier-only hidden entropy, then obtain 25 distinct exact expert-only Harbor records before any one-candidate model pilot.
hardness_assessment: Implementation is scientifically worthwhile as a post-snapshot reserve: unlike solved controls 107 and 111, the answer is not a diagnostic scalar or a fixed contraction. It must co-synthesize a physical gate order, functional flag window, calibrated implementation choices, and a full common-recovery policy, and those choices alter two independent verifier paths. GPT-5.6-sol/high difficulty is still only a design prior. Any clean target-model pass, real-TensorCircuit incompatibility, or failure of multi-seed admission vetoes promotion. Recommendation: HOLD/design_only until the listed human and execution gates pass.
